thread:
lila_sales: Heads-up — ClearWave Bank asked for a SOC 2 snapshot, ISO summary, signed pen-test letter, logical network diagram, and a brief KMS separation note for a POC. They want a zip we can upload to or they can download from. Customer requested a signed attestation by next Friday. Any blockers?
kevin_se: Quick q — is this for Hosted API or Dedicated/Private? Pen-test scope and what we share depends on environment.
lila_sales: Hosted for the POC. They said Dedicated might follow later but for now it’s docs-only (no production access).
nora_security: We can provide the following: redacted SOC 2 Type II summary, ISO 27001 scope statement, logical network diagram (no internal IPs), KMS/key separation description, and our pen-test attestation template.
	- Note: we cannot share raw vuln scan logs, internal backlog items, or private keys.
	- For a "signed pen-test letter": third-party vendor typically signs the pen-test report. We can provide a Redwood-signed attestation that we commissioned/received a pen-test on DATE and remedied identified high sev items, but final vendor signature comes from the tester.
sam_legal: Confirmed. Legal can sign a Redwood attestation PDF stating engagement + remediation status. We’ll provide a vendor-agnostic pen-test letter template that the customer/vendor can use. If customer legal redlines, send them to me and I’ll respond.
mike_eng: I can assemble the logical diagram and KMS/keyflow doc. I’ll also create an S3 presigned URL for the evidence bundle. ETA: diagram + KMS doc in ~24h, presigned URL now if security ok.
deploy-bot: presigned_url_created: https://s3.amazonaws.com/compliance-redwood/clearwave-poc/evidence_bundle.zip?X-Amz-Algorithm=AWS4-HMAC-SHA256&X-Amz-Expires=604800
kevin_se: For the presigned URL lets scope it to a single object and set a 7-day expiry and require TLS (the link is HTTPS so fine). Recommend we ask customer to include a manifest.txt at top-level listing file names and sha256 checksums. Also request an originating IP range if they want extra assurance.
lila_sales: ClearWave asked for a chain-of-custody style confirmation. Can we provide manifest + signed checksum after we receive upload?
nora_security: Yes — have them upload manifest.txt with checksums. After upload, our SOC team will verify checksums, timestamp receipt, and issue a short signed receiving attestation (PDF) stating date/time, checksum list, and who received it.
sam_legal: We can e-sign the attestation (DocuSign) for the Redwood side. For the vendor pen-test letter (if they want vendor signature) we’ll include a clause indicating the pen-test date and scope and attach the vendor report when available.
lila_sales: :thumbsup: OK — plan to communicate to customer today: share high-level list of artifacts we can provide and timeline. Mike — paste the presigned URL and upload instructions here. Nora/Sam — can you aim to have the attestation + pen-test template by EOD tomorrow? I need something to show legal/compliance at the bank today (high-level ok).
mike_eng: Upload instructions (paste to customer):
```
1) Download evidence_bundle.zip from the URL.
2) To upload your artifacts, put them into a .zip named clearwave_customer_artifacts.zip and include a manifest.txt at top-level with sha256 checksums, e.g.:
   1f2d3e4...  clearwave_config.yml
   a9b8c7d...  manifest.txt
3) Upload via the presigned URL (PUT). Example: `curl -X PUT -T clearwave_customer_artifacts.zip "<presigned_url>"`
Note: URL expires in 7 days. Contact support if you need extension.
```
kevin_se: Also include the recommended manifest template in the message to reduce back-and-forth.
lila_sales: Great — I’ll message the customer. Thanks everyone. I’ll follow up if they request vendor-signed pen-test or an on-site attestation.
